introHtml: Aluminum golf divot tools offer a durable yet lightweight option for keeping greens in top shape. Unlike plastic tools that can break or steel ones that rust, aluminum resists corrosion and feels substantial in hand. Customize them with your logo through screen printing or engraving for a polished look at corporate outings or charity tournaments. These tools pair well with our 22 oz Aluminum Bottle for a coordinated premium giveaway set.
